root_cause.text: The `wiphy_unregister()` function in the cfg80211 subsystem fails to cancel the pending `rfkill_block` work item before destroying the device resources, causing a use-after-free when the work executes subsequently.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states "the rfkill_block work is not cancelled when wiphy is being unregistered" and reports a KASAN use-after-free in `cfg80211_shutdown_all_interfaces` triggered by `cfg80211_rfkill_block_work`, while the patch fixes this by adding `cancel_work_sync(&rdev->rfkill_block);` inside `wiphy_unregister()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes missing cleanup of rfkill_block work during wiphy unregister to prevent race conditions.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to cancel_work_sync(&rdev->rfkill_block) within the wiphy_unregister function.
intent_record.how: Ensures that any pending rfkill_block work item is cancelled and completed before the wiphy structure is destroyed, preventing potential use-after-free or race conditions on freed resources.
